DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis.

Based on your 11-year history of a chronic cough producing copious, thick, foamy, yellow-green sputum that is worse in the morning, along with recurrent bronchitis episodes in a non-smoker, I am confident this is bronchiectasis.
